title: Experiments
description: Experiments and studies are organized by evidence type so that computational, simulated, and hardware results remain explicitly distinguishable.

evidence_types.name: Simulations
evidence_types.description: Model-based studies in which results are generated from defined computational or mathematical models rather than direct physical measurement.

evidence_types.name: Computational Studies
evidence_types.description: Software-based experiments, benchmarks, numerical analysis, pattern discovery, and other reproducible computational investigations.

evidence_types.name: Hardware Validation
evidence_types.description: Physical measurements and hardware tests intended to compare implemented systems with their corresponding models or design expectations.
